one_next_hypothesis.falsifies_if: Certified reference agrees with192 where dense64 disagrees, or independent coordinate/formula audit identifies a scale or implementation error instead.
one_next_hypothesis.hypothesis: The dominant n8 disagreement is under-resolution of a narrow Gaussian kernel on physically large known triangles at late t, governed in part by subtriangle diameter / s(t), rather than a wrong n label or duplicated model-coordinate scale.
one_next_hypothesis.priority: Before another model experiment, independently certify quadrature on these unchanged frozen failed pairs.
one_next_hypothesis.supports_if: Certified reference preserves >0.01 discrepancies on the same large cell_edge/s late-time pairs and finer local integration resolves them without changing coordinates or bandwidth.
one_next_hypothesis.test: In a separately authorized offline numerical task, keep C/query/t/sigma/bandwidth fixed, obtain an independent error-controlled triangle-integral reference on the same predeclared pairs, first certify reference tolerance <0.001, then compare frozen192 results and the registered cell_edge/s ordering. Do not train a model or select queries from new outcomes.
